headline: KOSPI Closes 6.02% Lower After Trading Halt
deck: South Korea’s KOSPI closed 6.02% lower after a 20-minute halt; Japan’s Nikkei fell about 6%.
body: South Korea’s KOSPI closed down 324.11 points, or 6.02%, at 5,059.69 after falling as low as 4,911.28, Yonhap reported. [E1]
The index had fallen more than 8% just after the opening bell, prompting the bourse operator to suspend KOSPI-stock trading for 20 minutes, Yonhap reported. [E2]
CNN reported that Japan’s Nikkei 225 fell about 6%. [E3]
The KOSPI close was below the 6,035 close the paper covered on Oct. 13. [E1][E4]
